snippet.title: Crankles - PreAlpha 0.3 - trailer
snippet.description:
Play as Crankles, a feline who despises everything and doesn't really care! Grab yarns, learns skills, defeat nasty dogs and uncover all the secrets on The Purring Island!

Wishlist now on Steam and join the play tests!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113670/?utm_source=YouTube

Follow us on Discord!
https://discord.com/invite/aXUeUUmcCT
